topic: query-unaware lossy projection combined with SAQ
selection_rule: Primary paper or official artifact for the closest projection, quantization, and staged-search mechanisms.

sources.title: SAQ: Pushing the Limits of Vector Quantization through Code Adjustment and Dimension Segmentation
sources.relevance: Defines dimension reduction as PCA plus tail discard and presents SAQ as combining dimension reduction with dimension balancing.

sources.title: ASH: Asymmetric Scalar Hashing With Learned Dimensionality Reduction for High-Fidelity Vector Quantization
sources.artifact_status: No official source artifact linked from arXiv v1.
sources.relevance: Direct collision for a learned global D-to-d projection and a fixed-payload tradeoff between uniform bitrate and derived retained dimension; primary formulation is inner product/cosine, while the squared-L2 extension uses query/index regression calibration that must be separated from a base-only admissible variant.

sources.title: Quantization Meets Projection: A Happy Marriage for Approximate k-Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.relevance: Closest collision for a PCA head, per-vector tail norm, dataset-level residual variances, quantized estimation, parameterized error bounds, and multi-stage IVF refinement; var-count and bound parameters require base-only preregistration.

sources.title: LeanVec: Searching vectors faster by making them fit
sources.artifact_status: Public SVS repository excludes proprietary LeanVec/LVQ source; distinguish projection control from packaged-system measurements.
sources.relevance: Combines linear dimensionality reduction and quantization; the in-distribution variant and primary/secondary representation are direct baselines, but reported target-d selection uses query performance and cannot be copied here.

sources.title: GleanVec: Accelerating vector search with minimalist nonlinear dimensionality reduction
sources.relevance: Covers linear sphering and cluster-adaptive piecewise-linear projection; the latter conflicts with the one-global-projection scope.

sources.title: Efficient Data-aware Distance Comparison Operations for High-Dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.relevance: DADE covers PCA/data-aware lower-dimensional distance estimation, adaptive hypothesis-tested work, and IVF/HNSW integration; the same comparison space includes random-projection ADSampling-style controls.

sources.title: Optimized Product Quantization
sources.relevance: Classical learned orthogonal transform optimized for quantization distortion; a control for any later learned projection objective.

sources.title: TurboQuant: Online Vector Quantization with Near-optimal Distortion Rate
sources.relevance: Modern random-rotation scalar quantizer and residual correction control; it does not physically project D to d.

sources.title: Matryoshka Representation Learning
sources.source_type: arXiv primary paper and official code
sources.relevance: Learns nested prefix embeddings at encoder-training time; relevant boundary but not a post-hoc projection baseline for fixed GIST vectors.

sources.title: AdANNS: A Framework for Adaptive Semantic Search
sources.source_type: OpenReview primary paper and official code
sources.relevance: Uses different nested dimensions across ANN stages; applies to Matryoshka embeddings rather than arbitrary fixed embeddings.
